verdict.rationale: There is no documented 'export all data' feature. Some paths exist to pull pieces of data out: the REST API manages workflows and sources, the CLI returns historical events, and emitted events can be consumed via the REST API or an SSE stream. Workflows are portable Node.js code, triggers and actions are source-available, and one community user judged migrating away to be low risk. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (workflows, data stores, event history, connected-account metadata) in open formats, any first-party guidance on migration or offboarding, and independent hands-on reports of actually exporting and leaving.
